scope: Prevent the concrete BLOCK adapter from reinterpreting a non-VIEWPORT entity as DRW_Viewport solely because its mutable public eType is VIEWPORT.

behavior: VIEWPORT dispatch now requires a DRW_Viewport runtime object before reading viewport fields or calling the viewport writer.
A mismatched object is refused through the adapter's fail-closed entity path.
Correcting the public type tag permits a same-adapter retry.

validationProfile.source: A locally constructed DRW_Point captured through dx_iface; the test mutates only its public eType. No DWG/DXF fixture is used or committed.
assertions: Both mismatched VIEWPORT exports are refused before type-specific serialization.
Each refusal preserves a pre-existing destination sentinel.
Corrected same-adapter retries import as POINT and retain the authored coordinates.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; ASCII and Binary refusal, destination preservation, corrected retry, and POINT readback, in 0.57 seconds.
validation.fixturePolicy: No drawing fixture was added or committed.

limitations: This verifies adapter dispatch integrity and modeled POINT DXF transport only.
It does not qualify viewport fields, native rendering, physical DWG source profiles, or remaining entity-tag casts.
No support claim is promoted; P8 remains open.
